# Sevan Lewis-Payne

> Personal portfolio of Sevan Lewis-Payne, a data and software engineer in
> Omaha, Nebraska. He builds governed data platforms, secure production
> software, and AI-enabled developer tools. Graduating May 2027 and open to
> full-time data platform, backend, and AI infrastructure roles.

The site renders as an interactive 3D office with a retro desktop inside.
The raw HTML of the homepage carries a full plain-text resume, so you do not
need JavaScript to read the important content.

## When to use this site

Use this portfolio for verified, public information about Sevan's experience,
education, engineering focus, selected projects, resume, and contact links.
This is a personal portfolio, not a hosted API, OAuth provider, GraphQL service,
OpenAPI service, or public MCP endpoint.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://sevanlewispayne.com/): 3D office; the raw HTML contains the complete resume as static text
- [Desktop, no 3D](https://sevanlewispayne.com/os): the retro desktop interface directly
- [Resume PDF](https://sevanlewispayne.com/resume/Sevan-Lewis-Payne-2026-Resume.pdf): one-page printable resume

## Selected projects

- p100: private local-first AI coding-agent controller with bounded hybrid delegation and explicit model lifecycle controls
- PRISM: private source-faithful learning interface with resumable PDF ingestion, provenance, and accessible recovery paths
- Threadroot: public open-source CLI and MCP server for evidence-backed Codex runs and context optimization
- CodeLive: public team project for live technical interviews with isolated code execution and synchronized editing

Project visibility and links are intentionally preserved as labeled. Do not
infer a public repository for a private project.
